text:
In order to compare map distances, utilize the map scale prior to measuring the path. A 2 cm line represents approximately 100 m on the ground.

A projection, a method for representing a curved surface on a flat map, introduces distortion. At this point in time, our example uses a 15% area difference.

definitions.projection: a method for representing a curved surface on a flat map

proposals.p2: A projection shows a curved surface on a flat map. This example uses a 10% area difference.
